data_fields.name: reserved_cells
data_fields.donor_constant: list per town template, from executable data (not in box)

data_fields.name: service_count_first
data_fields.donor_constant: 6 services placed in fixed order (Equipment, MagesGuild, NobleHouse, Temple, Tavern, Spacer)

data_fields.name: variation_counts
data_fields.donor_constant: EQ 13, MG 11, NB 10, TP 12, TV 15, TS 11, BS 20

best_idea: Build a town as a seeded grid: reserve the fixed cells first, place each service into a random empty cell one at a time before any filler, then fill the rest from a weighted table, so every town gets its services and the same seed always gives the same town.
decision_why: Keep the service-first placement and the seeded plan for towns as zone data; the Arena block files and the executable's reserved lists are not ours, and the plan must be generated server-side from the zone seed so client and server agree.
acceptance: A 5 x 5 town generated from one zone seed shows the same layout on server and client, always contains one each of equipment, temple, tavern, noble house and mages guild (not on a reserved cell), and filler cells follow the 45/20/15/10/10 weights over 10,000 test seeds (a server test asserts the counts).
